map.本工具模拟 TinyURL 服务生成短码（不会创建真实可访问的链接，仅供演示）。: This tool simulates the TinyURL service to generate a short code (it does NOT create a real accessible link, for demonstration only).
map.短链接生成原理的本地模拟。: A local simulation of short-link generation.
map.：服务端把长 URL 存入数据库并分配短码，访问短链时返回 301/302 跳转: : the server stores the long URL in a database and assigns a short code; visiting the short link returns a 301/302 redirect to the original address.
map.：常由自增 ID 经 Base62 编码生成，也可随机生成后查重。: : usually generated by Base62-encoding an auto-incrementing ID, or randomly generated then checked for duplicates.
map.：301 为永久重定向会被浏览器缓存，302 为临时重定向便于统计。: : 301 is a permanent redirect cached by the browser; 302 is a temporary redirect better for analytics.
map.：本工具在本地演示编码与映射，生成的短链不具备真实跳转服务。: : this tool demonstrates encoding and mapping locally; the generated short link has no real redirection service.
map.演示短链的映射与编码过程：输入长链接看它如何变成短码，便于理解短链服务的原理。: Demonstrate the mapping and encoding of a short link: input a long URL to see how it becomes a short code, helping understand how short-link services work.
map.输入长链 → 返回短标识，说明映射存储机制。: Input long link → return a short identifier, explaining the mapping storage mechanism.
map.与真实 TinyURL 区别？: How is it different from the real TinyURL?
map.仅为本地模拟，无真实解析服务。: It is only a local simulation with no real resolution service.
map.为什么自己搭短链要考虑防滥用？: Why consider abuse prevention when building your own short links?
map.因为短链会掩盖真实目标：用户无法从短码判断会跳到哪里，天然适合钓鱼与违规内容传播: Because a short link hides the real destination: users cannot tell where a code will jump to, making it ideal for phishing and spreading prohibited content. A self-hosted service should add target-address safety checks, access rate limits, a reporting entry and auditable logs, and state clear terms of service. Also the short-code space must be large enough and unpredictable to avoid brute-force enumeration.
map.TinyURL 模拟器。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏览器。: TinyURL Simulator. Built for developers, runs purely in the frontend; your code never leaves the browser.
